Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 7320U (4C / 8T, 2.4GHz / up to 4.1GHz, 4MB L2 + 8MB L3 Cache)
 Graphics: Integrated AMD Radeon Graphics
 Operating system: Windows 11 Pro, English
 Memory: Up to 16GB DDR5 (1x SO-DIMM, Max 32GB)
 Hard Drive: Up to 2TB SSD M.2 2242 PCIe 3.0x4 NVMe (Supports up to 2 drives: 1x 2.5" HDD up to 1TB + 1x M.2 SSD up to 512GB)
 Display: 15.6" FHD (1920 x 1080) TN, 250 nits, Anti-glare
 Connectivity: Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac 2x2) and Bluetooth 5.1
 Audio: 2x 1.5W Stereo Speakers, Dolby Audio
 Keyboard: Full-size Numeric Keyboard, US English
 Built-in HD Webcam: 720p HD Camera with Privacy Shutter
 Ports: 1 x USB 2.0; 1 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A; 1 x USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 (data only); 1 x HDMI 1.4b; 1 x Ethernet RJ-45; 1 x Headphone/Microphone Combo Jack; 1 x Power Connector
 Color: Black
 Dimensions L x W x H (inches): 14.14 x 9.28 x 0.78
 Weight: 3.75 lbs

items: 【AI-Function】Boost your productivity with the AI-driven Windows Copilot, offering intelligent task management, personalized assistance, and smart recommendations to make your daily tasks more efficient and intuitive.

【Processor】 Powered by AMD Ryzen 3 7320U processor with 4 cores and 8 threads, delivering up to 4.1GHz performance. This efficient yet powerful processor provides smooth speed for multitasking, productivity, streaming, and everyday use — making it an excellent choice for students and home users who need stronger performance. Includes integrated AMD Radeon Graphics for clear and responsive visuals.

【Operating System】 Pre-installed with Windows 11 Pro 64-bit, offering advanced security, streamlined productivity tools, and enterprise-grade management features. Ideal for both professional and educational environments, it ensures a modern, intuitive interface with seamless compatibility for business applications and remote collaboration.

【Key Features】Equipped with Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.1, USB-C (data transfer only), USB 3.2 Gen 1, USB 2.0, HDMI 1.4b, Ethernet, and a full-size non-backlit keyboard with numeric keypad for reliable connectivity and input. Features a buttonless Mylar precision touchpad and a 720p HD webcam with privacy shutter for secure and clear video calls. Powered by a 38Wh battery with efficient 45W charging for everyday productivity.
【Display】15.6-inch Full HD (1920 x 1080) anti-glare IPS display provides crystal-clear visuals with wide viewing angles, ideal for work, entertainment, and reducing eye strain during extended use
